title: Zhejiang University Yuquan campus map
question: Create a refined hand-drawn orientation map of Zhejiang University Yuquan Campus. Fact anchors: Yuquan Campus is at 38 Zheda Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou; it is within walking distance of West Lake and Hangzhou Botanical Garden; it backs onto Laohe Mountain. The only clickable regions are Zheda Road 38 Entrance, Campus Main Walk, Teaching and Engineering Buildings, Yuquan Library, Hangzhou Botanical Garden Edge, and Laohe Mountain Green Backdrop. Explain orientation, campus use, and visiting or study context for each region. Do not invent specific building names, false gate names, exact street geometry, or a precise floor-plan-style campus layout.
